== Description ==
Hay Day - A Guide to the Fishing Area.

Want to know about the machines, the lures, the fish, the diamonds, the events, plus much more then check out this video. It will answer many of your questions, show some good examples of how to catch fish, what prizes you get from the mystery nets and give tips.

Fishing Boat (35,000 gold), - (lvl 27) max 1 - 3d or 97 diamonds
Fishing areas: Open with LEM
